title: Users
adminOnly: The user directory is for system administrators.
hint: People only; service accounts are on the API keys page. Showing at most 100.

erase.explain: Erasure pseudonymises this person: their e-mail and name are replaced, sign-in and API keys stop working, memberships are removed and their open tasks return to the queue. Annotations they made stay, under an anonymous id. This cannot be undone.
erase.redactComments: Also replace the text of their comments with “[erased]”

scim.heading: SCIM provisioning
scim.description: Let your identity provider (Entra ID, Okta, …) create, update and deactivate accounts and push groups before anyone signs in. Groups grant project roles through each project's single sign-on group mapping. Enter the tenant URL and token in the provider's provisioning settings.
scim.newTokenHint: The token was shown once when it was made. A new token replaces it; update the provider afterwards.
scim.revealTitle: Copy these into your identity provider now. The token is not shown again.
